findings.summary: A host error on a resume claim before the next step's action exists re-enqueues under the same dedup key while the claimed row exists; finish_work marks it DONE and the run is stranded RUNNING with no pending work
Removing the resume dedup survives the suite; the 'one item' test relies on has_pending_work; a racing second recovery test is missing
No recorded Postgres run at 40ba1a7 of test_migrations and the resume-kind conformance test; gate pg covers tests/unit/kernel only
